library.name: MiniFFTDx
library.summary: Compile-time described FFTs. Build a description by adding operators with operator+, wrap it in FFT<>, then call FFT<>::execute on host memory. Everything lives in namespace minifftdx; include <minifftdx.hpp>.

enums.name: fft_type
enums.doc: Kind of transform: complex-to-complex, real-to-complex, complex-to-real.

enums.name: fft_direction
enums.doc: Transform direction. Inverse transforms are NOT normalized (no 1/N scaling).

operators.name: Size
operators.doc: Transform length: the number of points of one FFT.

constraints.message: Size<N> operator is required
Size must be a power of two in the range [2, 4096]
ElementsPerThread must evenly divide Size
FFTsPerBlock * Size * sizeof(complex) must not exceed 48 KiB of shared memory

operators.name: Precision
operators.doc: Floating point type of the real and imaginary parts.

constraints.message: Precision must be float or double
Type<fft_type> operator is required
Direction conflicts with Type: r2c is forward-only and c2r is inverse-only

operators.name: Direction
operators.doc: Direction of the transform (see fft_direction). Required for c2c; implied by the type for r2c (forward) and c2r (inverse), where it may be omitted.

constraints.message: Direction<> is required for c2c transforms
Direction conflicts with Type: r2c is forward-only and c2r is inverse-only

operators.name: ElementsPerThread
operators.doc: Number of elements each (virtual) thread holds. Must divide Size.

constraints.message: ElementsPerThread must evenly divide Size

operators.name: FFTsPerBlock
operators.doc: Number of independent FFTs processed together by one execute_batch group.

constraints.message: FFTsPerBlock must be in the range [1, 64]
FFTsPerBlock * Size * sizeof(complex) must not exceed 48 KiB of shared memory

operators.name: SM
operators.doc: Target GPU architecture (compute capability times 100). Only validated, since MiniFFTDx executes on the host.

constraints.message: double precision requires SM >= 800

operators.name: Block
operators.doc: Marker operator selecting block-level (cooperative) execution. Optional.

combinators.name: operator+
combinators.signature: template<class A, class B, class > auto operator+(const A &, const B &)

template_params.default: std :: enable_if_t < ( detail :: is_operator_v < A > || detail :: is_description_v < A > ) && ( detail :: is_operator_v < B > || detail :: is_description_v < B > ) >>

combinators.doc: Combine two operators and/or descriptions into one Description. This is the only way to build a description: Size<64>() + Type<fft_type::c2c>() + ...

entries.name: FFT
entries.doc: A host-executable FFT described by Desc (a Description built with operator+). Constraints are enforced with static_assert when FFT<Desc> is instantiated. Execution is in place for c2c, out of place for r2c and c2r. Inverse transforms are not normalized. r2c produces size/2+1 complex outputs; c2r consumes size/2+1 complex inputs and writes size real outputs.

members.name: size
members.doc: Number of points of one FFT.

members.name: ffts_per_block
members.doc: Number of FFTs per execute_batch group (default 1).

members.name: threads_per_fft
members.doc: Threads needed for one FFT: Size / ElementsPerThread.

members.name: storage_size
members.doc: Per-thread register storage in elements (== elements_per_thread).

members.name: shared_memory_size
members.doc: Shared memory bytes needed by one group: FFTsPerBlock * Size * sizeof(complex).

members.name: input_length
members.doc: Number of input elements per FFT (c2c: size, r2c: size reals, c2r: size/2+1).

members.name: output_length
members.doc: Number of output elements per FFT (c2c: size, r2c: size/2+1, c2r: size reals).

members.name: execute
members.doc: In-place c2c transform of `size` elements. Only valid for Type<fft_type::c2c>.

members.name: execute
members.signature: void execute(const real_type * in, value_type * out) const
members.doc: r2c: `size` real inputs -> size/2+1 complex outputs. Only valid for Type<fft_type::r2c>.

members.name: execute
members.signature: void execute(const value_type * in, real_type * out) const
members.doc: c2r: size/2+1 complex inputs (Hermitian half spectrum) -> `size` real outputs, unnormalized. Only valid for Type<fft_type::c2r>.

members.name: execute_batch
members.signature: void execute_batch(value_type * data, unsigned int batch) const
members.doc: c2c transform of `batch` contiguous FFTs (batch * size elements), in place.

constraints.message: FFT requires a Description built by adding operators with operator+
Size<N> operator is required
Type<fft_type> operator is required
Size must be a power of two in the range [2, 4096]
Precision must be float or double
Direction<> is required for c2c transforms
Direction conflicts with Type: r2c is forward-only and c2r is inverse-only
ElementsPerThread must evenly divide Size
FFTsPerBlock must be in the range [1, 64]
double precision requires SM >= 800
FFTsPerBlock * Size * sizeof(complex) must not exceed 48 KiB of shared memory
execute(data) is only available for c2c transforms; use execute(in, out) for r2c/c2r
execute(const real*, complex*) is only available for r2c transforms
execute(const complex*, real*) is only available for c2r transforms
execute_batch is only available for c2c transforms

traits.name: is_supported
traits.doc: Non-asserting check: true when Desc is a complete, valid FFT description. Use it to test a configuration without triggering a compile error.

functions.name: reference_dft
functions.signature:
template void reference_dft(const std::complex

* in, std::complex

* out, unsigned int n, fft_direction dir)
functions.doc: Naive O(N^2) reference DFT, useful to check results. Direction as in fft_direction; inverse is unnormalized.
